title: Runtime Is the New Security Frontier
author: Eliot Ferstl
excerpt: Prevention and perimeter tools stop known threats at the door. The harder problem lives at runtime, after workloads start doing real work.

title: Building Defense That Assumes Compromise
author: Eliot Ferstl
excerpt: Designing for a world where compromise is assumed changes what you build — it means planning for the moment defenses are already inside the perimeter.
